name: TRAPPIST-1
blurb: An ultra-cool dwarf star with seven Earth-size planets — one of the most compact known planetary systems.
highlights: All seven planets orbit closer than Mercury does to the Sun
Several planets sit in or near the star's habitable zone
Host is a small, cool M-dwarf (TRAPPIST-1)
compactnessNote: All seven planets lie well inside Mercury's orbital distance from the Sun — a packed, short-period system.
